worktreeSettings.title: Worktree settings for {{project}}
worktreeSettings.description: How Kettu names and prepares the worktrees of new sessions in this project.
worktreeSettings.branchHint: {slug} is a few words from the first message, {type} the kind of change and {issue} an issue number. The default is kettu/{slug}.
worktreeSettings.copyHint: Paths relative to the project, one per line, copied into each new worktree. The project’s .worktreeinclude is read too.
worktreeSettings.setupHint: Runs in each new worktree, such as to install dependencies. Leave it empty to run none.
worktreeSettings.waitHint: The agent starts once the files are copied and the command has finished.
worktreeSettings.forbidden: Only the owner of this host can change these from here, unless they let paired devices use its terminal.

projectFolders.title: Folders of {{project}}

projectFolders.removed: {{name}} is out of the project. Its files stay where they are.
projectFolders.foundHint: Git repositories inside the folder, and folders a .code-workspace file lists.
projectFolders.noneFound: No other repositories or workspace folders found.
projectFolders.worktrees: Worktrees are off while the project has several folders: one would set apart only the project folder.
